name: PLTD transfers to its pair burn from the pair without sync
summary: PLTD's transfer deducts tokens from the PLTD/USDT pair's own balance on every transfer to it, without calling sync(), so the attacker shrank the pair's PLTD reserve and swapped out its USDT at the inflated rate.
notes: The reset is the owner's changeRouter call that stored the PLTD/USDT pair the transfer branch acts on (slot 0x14); later fee changes only set rates. Loss is the pair's USDT; its PLTD is valued at nothing (rule 12).
